title: Proposed Inquiry By Select Committee Into IRD Operations
content:
11 February 1999

Proposed Inquiry By Select Committee Into IRD Operations

  • Bill English
Revenue

Revenue Minister Bill English said today he would be interested in hearing more on the intentions of the Finance and Expenditure Committee regarding a proposed review into Inland Revenue Department operations.

Mr English said he intended discussing the proposal with Government members of the Committee.
